question: Does native contradiction-gated factual memory learn TWO fresh unfamiliar causal operator families more reliably from 16 matched chosen-action consequences than ungated native memory and fully trained conventional controls, and does 16 improve over 6 on same sources?

lineage.architecture: Independent native tokenless causal memory; no copying language model or symbolic operator engine

hypotheses.primary: Native contradiction-gated 16-observation memory exceeds the strongest fully trained nonengineered 16-observation conventional comparator on unfamiliar heldout operators in each of 3 seeds.
hypotheses.microfeedback: Contradiction-gated native memory beats equal-capacity ungated, zero-outcome, shuffled-feedback and memory-reset arms with same source/action/compute.
hypotheses.informativeness: Native-16 improves over native-6 from the identical first six factual support outcomes and same heldout query; no query adaptation or extra private labels.
hypotheses.native_specific: Native internal memory improves over an external learned-memory adapter at equal trainable capacity, information and compute.
hypotheses.retention_and_reversal: Native gain survives delayed cold queries, physics role changes, and a genuine precommitted mid-support hidden-operator reversal.

source.support_actions: Exactly 8 CALIBRATE and 8 EXPLOIT_POS fixed alternating factual physical actions; one actual selected return each. Same episode hidden operator with independently regenerated physical factor worlds.
source.six_support_control: Only first 6 of the same 16 chosen support actions and their factual rewards; never show indices 6..15 or missingness correlated with operator.
source.family_assignment: Balanced joint public pivot/time x chosen heldout query action x hidden operator, not determined by public index parity or any stable role/time code.
source.query: Independently drawn heldout physical state after all supports, only chosen FIT/VALID query return for training. Evaluator-only paired query returns on heldout DEV after all models fully trained.
source.truth_policy: Boolean family truth tables, private law and physical factors implemented evaluator-only, never called or copied into learner. No teacher/algebra/privileged counterfactual in learner.
source.freshness: Distinct R102 salts, seeds and source from R101 all panels; absolutely no prior R101 world/unit fixture/weights or scored cohort reuse.
source.observation: Public noisy R85 224-tick physical A cues/operand-role markers and selected action/time. No private opcode or hidden family identifier.
source.reversal: Hidden operator changes after 8 factual supports from the opposite registered unknown family; must change in 100% of reversal episodes.
source.source_generation: Deterministic per registered panel/seed/index/event without reward-based redraw or postscore adjustment.
source.source_balances: Pre-first-use joint family-by-observable pivot/time/action and role labels must pass; fail closed on any shortcut.

models.reference: R74 native width32 TTT+SSM+causal attention+depth, used only as isolated CPU source adapter; model.py untouched.
models.native_gate: Differentiable online gate predicted from public preaction cues, previously predicted factual return and actually realized selected return; never hidden truth.
models.same_capacity_ungated: Same width and actively trainable gate network, with contradiction residual removed but same factual reward and public cues; same optimizer/steps.
models.external: Same native core and factual observations, actively trained external episode-state adapter within 10% parameters and verified active compute where possible.
models.conventional: Full-step trainable GRU64, role-set64, flattened 16-support MLP and static prior, all with same information and action history; strongest is the control.
models.six_vs_sixteen: Native 6-support has the same architecture and initialization and first 6 same factual observations; no extra private info.

evaluation.primary: Physically realized heldout DEV_UNKNOWN selected-action reward on truly fresh EXACTLY_TWO3 and ALL_EQUAL3 after 16 factual support interventions

engineering.qualifications: Existing G4 Linux and Windows full final regression, G5 authentic TTT CPU, G7 Mamba2 CPU
